text: Charissa Iogna, Senior Project Manager (A), Transportation Services will provide a presentation on temporary Storefront Entry Ramps on the Public Right-of-Way as directed by Infrastructure and Environment Committee. This presentation will provide an update on the reporting history, consultation findings, and an overview of the Placement Guidelines of temporary ramps being used by storefronts with a stepped entrance that abuts the public right-of-way.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
